decision.summary: SC001-H1-001 DESIGN_ONLY package is complete and ready for Strategy review. It freezes 8 bounded variants across P1/P2/P3/P4/P7, zero interactions/composites/horizon alternatives, conservative contamination handling, and a Selection→Discovery→Asset Holdout→Chronological Confirmation allocation. No historical dataset is certified untouched by this task because raw/local/network source bodies were not inspected. The manifest experiment_id field uses the task ID solely to satisfy the canonical manifest schema; no new research experiment ID was created. PROPOSED_SHARED_STATE_CHANGE: none.
allowed_claims: The prefreeze design package exists and is internally consistent with DESIGN_ONLY boundaries.
Eight variants across five required primitive families are prospectively defined.
No historical outcome, PnL, return, protected P1 evidence, network acquisition or VPS raw data was accessed.
No historical dataset is certified untouched by this task.
The package is ready for Strategy review, not for outcome-bearing execution.
forbidden_reuse: Do not treat the benchmark definitions as evidence that any indicator has alpha or economic value.
Do not execute historical outcome-bearing runs without a new explicit Strategy/User task.
Do not reuse terminal SC001 outcome windows as promotional evidence.
Do not open protected/raw P1 evidence under this package.
Do not add parameter, horizon, symbol, hour, venue or interaction searches to v0.1.
Do not mutate roadmap, governance, Strategy State, contamination registry, reusable-block registry or routing architecture from this worker result.
decision.next_allowed_action: Strategy Manager reviews the prefreeze. If approved, dispatch a separate bounded source-only metadata/prior-use audit to resolve exact coverage, resource identity, volume semantics and clean evidence allocation before any outcome-bearing run.
